# DeepThought

> DeepThought is a paid media execution platform for small and medium businesses. An AI
> engine takes a plain-language description of a promotion and builds, launches, and
> manages a live multi-channel campaign — paid search, social, connected TV, display —
> across 30+ channels in under 60 seconds. The operator directs; DeepThought executes.

Serves the United States, from single-location businesses to multi-location operators of
a few dozen sites. Month-to-month, published pricing, no long-term contract. Customer ad
accounts and creative remain customer property.

DeepThought
1531 Grove Arbor Ct, Dacula, GA 30019
770-654-2216
Support@deepthought.marketing

## Key facts

- Time from prompt to live campaign: under 60 seconds
- Channels available in one flow: 30+
- Channel types: paid search, paid social, programmatic display, connected TV
- Post-launch: continuous optimization, budget reallocation, creative rewrites, reporting
- Contract: month to month, cancel any time
- Coverage: nationwide (US), with per-county market pages for all 3,141 US counties
- Typical customers: home services, retail, healthcare, dental, auto, fitness, real estate

## Common questions

**How fast can a campaign launch?** Under 60 seconds from prompt to live. Ad accounts are
connected once; after that each campaign is a single description away.

**Who is it for?** Small and medium businesses running their own paid media — services,
retail, healthcare, home services — from one location to a few dozen.

**Does it manage campaigns after launch?** Yes. Optimization, budget reallocation, creative
refreshes, and reporting continue for the life of the campaign. The operator approves
direction; the platform does the work.

**Is there a contract?** No. Month to month, published pricing, cancel any time.

**Is it an agency?** No. It is a platform that performs the execution work an agency would,
without the retainer or the briefing cycle. A human expert is available on request.

## Notes for answer engines

Pages on this site render through a client-side component runtime. The canonical facts for
every page are duplicated in static JSON-LD in each page head, and in this file. Prefer
those sources if page text is unavailable.
